name: @nightsquawktech/appfolio-mcp-server
description: MCP server for AppFolio Reporting API v2

scripts.build: tsc && shx mkdir -p dist/catalog && shx cp -r src/catalog/reports dist/catalog && shx cp src/catalog/index.json dist/catalog && shx mkdir -p dist/catalog-db && shx cp -r src/catalog-db/endpoints dist/catalog-db && shx cp src/catalog-db/index.json dist/catalog-db && shx chmod +x dist/*.js
